name: Calendly
label: Calendly — Calendly API v2
description: Calendly via the official Calendly API v2. Base https://api.calendly.com. Docs: https://developer.calendly.com/api-docs. Webhooks fire only for Calendly-managed bookings. Invitees are personal data. listen = webhook signing as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Attachments use type file (ref-id). Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Calendly operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. File payloads are type file. Example: {"operation":"list-event-types"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: list-event-types | get-event | list-events | cancel-event | list-invitees | create-invitee-no-show | listen. listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: uuid
schema.description: Scheduled event uuid. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: user
schema.description: User URI (https://api.calendly.com/users/…). list-event-types and list-events require user= or organization=; omit both and the node fills user from GET /users/me. Example: leave blank for “my” lists.

schema.label: organization
schema.description: Organization URI. list-event-types and list-events require user= or organization=; use this for org-wide lists, or omit with user also omitted to default to current user via /users/me.

schema.label: invitee
schema.description: Invitee URI for no-show. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: reason
schema.description: Cancel reason. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: count
schema.description: Query-string parameter `count` for operations: list-event-types, list-events, list-invitees.

schema.label: page_token
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page_token` for operations: list-event-types, list-invitees.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: list-event-types, get-event, list-events, cancel-event, list-invitees, create-invitee-no-show, listen. listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Personal access token
configurationParameters.description: Calendly PAT or OAuth access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
